desc:
Welcome to Build Base & Steal Weapons! Build the Strongest Base and defend it with your Weapons!

🔥Your Weapons can also shoot Stealers!🔥

How to play:
🎲Open Crates, Buy Rare Weapons
💵Place to earn money!
🔨Build the Strongest base to Defend from other Players!
🥷Steal from other Players!
👑Rebirth for 10x money!

👍 Like the game and join the group for an OP Weapon!
